record.summary: No qualifying institute identified. In April 2026, Yemeni and Egyptian ministers discussed digital transformation and digital capacity building.

partial.scope: Negative-status confidence, preserved query provenance, national/official-language search coverage and source-independence audit; this is not a full recheck of all record fields.

Reassessed negative confidence under the revised rule using saved research. No retained English query. The retrieved material does not sufficiently establish the national AI governance arrangements. No new search or full recheck.
Attempted preservation of cited source copies and checked saved-copy hashes; failures remain in source access notes. This source-evidence work is not a full factual recheck of the record.

English searches for a national AI safety, security or evaluation institute, commitment, proposal or study. English searches found no qualifying institute, national commitment or government study. Available leads concern digital-transformation cooperation and academic/education proposals. The selected Egyptian government cooperation page failed to fetch, and no substantive national AI governance primary was established in this pass. Partial check only; the last full-check date is unchanged.

Re-ran searches in Arabic and English for a government-designated institute that evaluates advanced models, or a commitment, proposal or study naming one. No qualifying institute or commitment was identified; Arabic and English searches returned no Yemeni AI policy, strategy or body. Kept low: no Yemeni AI governance source was found. Partial check; the last full-check date is unchanged.

check.language_note: The recorded ar query uses a national or official language selected for this country-specific check. Other national or official languages were not exhaustively searched. Search source_ids identify registered source URLs matched in the retrieved result set, which may include irrelevant hits. An empty list means no registered source URL was matched, not that the web response was empty. The earlier audit used independent_source_ids for substantive corroboration; governance_source_ids, where present, identifies the selected primary governance evidence. English queries were also run on 17 October 2026; the previously recorded national or official-language coverage and its limits are unchanged. On 24 October 2026 the record was searched again in Arabic and English; the result links of each query were matched against registered sources in the same way.
check.independence_note: Historical audit under the superseded two-independent-sources rule: Two substantively independent evidence origins were not established. Multiple pages from one owner, mirrors, reports of the same underlying announcement and general regional coverage are not counted as independent corroboration.

record.notes: Official information is scarce. The communications ministry's stated priorities in April 2026 (rehabilitating infrastructure, e-government roadmap, possible 5G) do not mention AI, and a 2025 academic study lists the lack of AI laws and regulations among the main obstacles. No government or UN source on Yemeni AI policy was found; evidence of absence is thin. Further web searches were not possible once the shared search budget ran out.

next_check.reason: Routine re-check on a two-year rotation of states with no reported plans.
